bootstrap_deployment_name.description: Suggested customer-owned bootstrap deployment name; only the customer applies it.

service_accounts.description: Bootstrap-owned Agent, Collector, and authenticated push identities.

secret_ids.description: Customer-owned credential secrets referenced by the Agent and Collector; deleting bootstrap leaves them intact.

collector_service_name.description: Bootstrap-owned Collector updated through the Cloud Run API by the Agent.

collector_service_url.description: Actual Collector service URL used by the authenticated push subscription.

logs_resource_names.description: Bootstrap-created log resources. The Agent updates only the sink through the Logging API.
